194:t_1:87.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm sorry. I'm... a little tired...」

194:t_1:88.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I can't blame you. But please don't give up hope.」

194:t_1:89.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Your songs give everyone hope.」

194:t_1:92.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...Hmph... You still look as gloomy as ever.」

194:t_1:93.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Do you think we can smile in a situation like this?」

194:t_1:94.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「You two... I hear you're famous singers.」

194:t_1:95.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Since you're here, sing something for us.」

194:t_1:96.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Sorry to disappoint you. We're... professionals.」

194:t_1:97.en:
$$シェリル$$
「I don't know any songs I'd sing for invaders, especially without getting paid.」

194:t_1:99.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「...Well, I guess that makes sense...」

194:t_1:101.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「I heard this planet still had music, so I was looking forward to it...」

194:t_1:102.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Damn... If we weren't on duty, we could have gone to that concert...」

194:t_1:104.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「They say some singers from Earth are coming to this city.」

194:t_1:106.en:
$$シェリル$$
「$$熱気バサラ$$ is coming...!」

194:t_1:110.en: ～$$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$ Concert Venue～

194:t_1:111.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Raaah! Let us hear it already!!」

194:t_1:113.en:
$$クラン$$
「Th-this crowd is really fired up!」

194:t_1:114.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I had my doubts, but Captain $$オズマ$$ was right.」

194:t_1:115.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「So $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ really is a huge hit in the Empire.」

194:t_1:116.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ reports that $$サイデリアル$$, a coalition of people from different planets, restricts culture to maintain control.」

194:t_1:117.en:
$$カナリア$$
「So they're starved for culture, and the elusive $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ has become something of a legend among them.」

194:t_1:118.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「It's like the $$ゼントラーディ$$ and the $$ミンメイ・ショック$$.」

194:t_1:119.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Nobody could stop this many people when they're this excited.」

194:t_1:120.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Even $$サイデリアル$$'s brass will have to turn a blind eye.」

194:t_1:121.en:
$$クラン$$
「B-but... isn't it a stretch to have us stand in for them...?」

194:t_1:122.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「She's got pointy ears and hardly any curves! That must be $$ミレーヌ$$ on bass!」

194:t_1:123.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That's the keyboard player with the dark skin! Play for us, $$レイ・ラブロック$$!」

194:t_1:124.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「That's the huge woman on drums! You're awesome, $$ビヒーダ$$!」

194:t_1:125.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「And there's the man with glasses! Is that the legendary $$熱気バサラ$$!?」

194:t_1:127.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「The costumes $$かなめ$$, $$エイミー$$ and I made seem to have helped.」

194:t_1:129.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「They'll play recordings through the PA. Are you ready, $$ルカ$$?」

194:t_1:130.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Yes. You'll all have to fake it by lip-syncing and pretending to play.」

194:t_1:132.en:
$$ルカ$$
「With a crowd this excited, we should be able to fool them to some extent.」

194:t_1:133.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm counting on you guys... We got the soldiers here. Now we need to buy as much time as we can.」

194:t_1:134.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I'm counting on you to get the crowd going too, Mr. Dancer!」

194:t_1:136.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well, let's get the operation... the concert started...!」

194:t_1:140.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
(I could get hooked on this...)

194:t_1:145.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...The concert should have started by now.」

194:t_1:146.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「From what we've seen so far, most of the soldiers in town seem to have crowded into the venue.」

194:t_1:147.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Your plan worked, Major $$オズマ$$.」

194:t_1:148.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I know how incredible $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ is better than anyone.」

194:t_1:149.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Now we just need our trump card to arrive in time...)

194:t_1:150.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「This is where the real work starts. Everyone, review your assignments.」

194:t_1:151.en:
$$スザク$$
「Team A will infiltrate the detention facility and free the prisoners.」

194:t_1:152.en:
$$マオ$$
「Team B will infiltrate $$ターミナル・ベース$$ and gather as much intelligence as possible.」

194:t_1:153.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Team C will create a diversion as the situation requires.」

194:t_1:154.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ラルク$$... You and $n are our trump cards. I'm counting on you.」

194:t_1:155.en:
$n
「Understood. When the time comes, I'll summon $$ジェニオン$$ and raise hell.」

194:t_1:156.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Come on! Give us a cool line like $n's, Big Sis!」

194:t_1:157.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...I understand the mission. What I can't accept is that you're coming along.」

194:t_1:158.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「We have little choice. She tagged along before we knew it.」

194:t_1:159.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Her incredible strength might prove useful. Don't be so cold to her, $$ラルク$$.」

194:t_1:160.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right, Big Sis! This is just when we need hard work and guts to make our mission a success!」

194:t_1:161.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'll do my job without you telling me. Hard work and guts have nothing to do with it.」

194:t_1:164.en:
$$タケル$$
「Are you all right, $$ラルク$$!?」

194:t_1:166.en:
???
「Heh heh heh... A little girl like that is your trump card?」

194:t_1:168.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is it $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!?」

194:t_1:169.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Correct. This is our first face-to-face meeting, $c.」

194:t_1:170.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$ラルク$$! Get out of here with $$ノノ$$ and carry out the operation!」
